imageryMethod.farmFieldPark: Inspected current Google Maps satellite view at the feature-linked map location. The access POI appears at the riverbank; the exact wet edge is not surveyed. No image file is archived, so treat imagery confirmation as qualitative and use 100-foot uncertainty.

mirabeauPark.imageryAttribution: Google Maps; Airbus/Maxar copyright 2026 (scene acquisition date not displayed)
mirabeauPark.view: Satellite, map center 47.68201,-117.223061, Google Maps 145m view parameter; visible 50-foot scale bar; viewport 1280x720, map canvas x=72..1279 and y=0..719.
mirabeauPark.conversion: Approximate local scale from the 50-foot bar (~74 px): selected toe is about 192 feet east and 54 feet south of the map center. Convert local east/north offsets to WGS84 at latitude 47.68201, yielding 47.68186,-117.22255. This is a reviewer georeference from the visible gravel-path toe, not a surveyed coordinate.

imageryMethod.otherSites: No other replacement coordinate was inferred from imagery. Access/trailhead coordinates remain source-backed area anchors; unresolved water-entry positions remain held.
